facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Beijing's entertainment and fashion district, Sanlitun.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Beijing Sanlitun is a modern luxury hotel in the heart of Beijing's vibrant entertainment and fashion district.

facts.text: The hotel is adjacent to the Embassy and Central Business District.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is situated adjacent to the Embassy and Central Business District

facts.text: Club InterContinental is on the 22nd floor, with floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and views over Sanlitun.

facts.text: CHAR is a steakhouse holding Black Pearl One Diamond and Michelin Plate accolades.

facts.text: CHAR serves premium steaks and wines with Sanlitun views in an open-kitchen setting.
